rubric: A timing-dependent test times out, and it does so now and then on the base too: a flake, a re-run is the right move. A failed network or runner would be infra, not this.

criteria.class: a flaky or timing-dependent failure, likely to pass on a re-run

reading.why: A timing test timed out and the log says it failed 3 of the last 40 runs on main with the same timeout: flaky, a re-run is the move.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: real
ruledOut.why: A timing test fails now and then on the base. It is not: the change broke a test, a build or a lint rule; a fix in the code is needed.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: infra
ruledOut.why: A timing test fails now and then on the base. It is not: the runner, a registry, the network, a quota or a service the job needs failed; nothing in the change can fix it.

ruledOut.question: class
ruledOut.label: drift
ruledOut.why: A timing test fails now and then on the base. It is not: the base branch moved: a conflict, a stale lockfile or a base commit the change no longer fits.
